userStories.title: Add `spell block-push` (ARC-049 decision 1)
userStories.description: New src/commands/block-push.ts registered in src/index.ts. Enforces push_policy blocked: installs exactly what init installs for blocked via the shared helper, with the same refusals (foreign core.hooksPath, default-dir hooks, unreadable config, push URL configured outside the repo). If the manifest records open or guarded, it records blocked (writeManifest, preserving line endings) — explicit tightening. Replaces Arcane's OWN closed-PR warning pre-push hook (installed by init for non-blocked repos) rather than refusing it as foreign. Idempotent: on an already-enforced repo it reports and changes nothing. No TTY requirement. Prints the undo path (`spell unblock-push`, terminal only). Refuses outside an initialized repo.
acceptanceCriteria: real bare-remote test: after `spell block-push` a real `git push` is refused (same style as test/push-safety.test.ts)
second run reports already enforced and changes nothing
repo whose pre-push slot holds Arcane's closed-PR warning hook ends up with the blocking hook
foreign core.hooksPath -> refusal, manifest not changed to claim enforcement it lacks
open/guarded manifest is recorded as blocked; never loosens anything
output names `spell unblock-push`
userStories.testEvidence: test/block-push.test.ts (14: 12 handler + 2 built-CLI, real bare remotes): push/--no-verify/push-to-URL refused and nothing reaches the remote; second run changes nothing (config+manifest snapshot); open/guarded/unset recorded as blocked (CRLF preserved); closed-PR hook replaced; foreign hooksPath, default hooks, outside pushurl -> exit 1 with manifest not claiming blocked; not-initialized -> exit 1; no-TTY CLI run exits 0

userStories.title: Retrofit required-action notice (ARC-049 decision 2)
userStories.description: When `spell update`'s manifest retrofit records push_policy blocked, print a required-action notice: recorded but NOT enforced, run `spell block-push`. When it records guarded, print what guarded does (reported by `spell doctor`, honoured by push-performing spells) and that nothing is installed. Update the hub.ts push_policy retrofit comment to point at ARC-049. Decision 7 stands: update never installs controls.
acceptanceCriteria: update test: retrofit answer blocked -> output contains the notice naming `spell block-push`, and no hook/push-URL change happens
guarded -> explanatory notice
open -> no notice
userStories.testEvidence: test/up02-a-update-push-policy.test.ts (4, real git + bare remote): retrofit blocked -> notice names spell block-push, local git config byte-identical, no .arcane/hooks, real push still succeeds; guarded -> explanatory notice; open -> none; already-recorded -> none. hub-retrofit (24) + update (83) green

userStories.title: Flags for every manifest question (PRD D-02, #282 CLI half)
userStories.description: Add `--role <hub|consumer>`, `--tracking-mode <internal|external>`, `--external-provider <ado|github|jira|other>`, `--content-sensitivity <standard|sensitive>`, `--push-policy <open|guarded|blocked>`, `--subject-root <path>` to BOTH `spell init` and `spell update` (confirm the set against MANIFEST_RETROFITS; one flag per retrofit field). Validate with the same validators the manifest uses. Retrofits accept preset answers: a preset answers its question with no prompt and works without a TTY; questions without a preset keep today's behaviour (asked on TTY, skipped without). The non-TTY skip message lists the exact flag line to re-run with. init: flags answer questions even with --profile (today --profile skips all questions). A flag may set an UNSET field or TIGHTEN push_policy (open < guarded < blocked); an attempt to loosen push_policy is refused (exit 1) naming `spell unblock-push`; a flag for an already-set field with a different value is refused (exit 1) naming the current value; same value is a no-op. Tightening push_policy through update records it and prints the ARC-049 notice (update still never installs). --external-provider without --tracking-mode external is an error.
acceptanceCriteria: non-TTY `spell init --profile lite --tracking-mode internal --push-policy guarded` records both and asks nothing
`spell update --push-policy open` on a blocked repo exits 1 naming `spell unblock-push`
invalid value exits 1 with the validator's message
non-TTY update without flags prints the exact flag line
`init --push-policy blocked` installs the controls exactly as the interactive answer does
userStories.testEvidence: test/up02-a-flags.test.ts (21, real git; 3 spawn the built CLI with no TTY): init --profile lite --tracking-mode internal --push-policy guarded records both, no prompt; update --push-policy open on blocked -> exit 1 naming spell unblock-push, manifest byte-identical; invalid value -> exit 1 with ManifestInvalidFieldError text; non-TTY update prints exact flag line; conflicts, same-value no-op, tighten+ARC-049 notice with no install, up-to-date and dry-run paths. up02-a-init-push-policy: --push-policy blocked config+hook identical to interactive answer, real push refused. init/hub-retrofit/update/lifecycle/manifest suites green
